Know what is separate.

Taxes & delivery

Tax is additional. Free standard US outbound shipping is proposed and must be confirmed before launch.

Rental & returns

Ownership, return postage, refund deductions and end-of-term deadlines need agreed commercial terms.

Clinical services

Professional assessment or clinician oversight is not included unless specifically stated in an approved offer.

Before you choose.

How much is the first year?

The proposed US offer is $499 for initial equipment rental plus $1,999 for the annual subscription: $2,498 before applicable tax. These are demo prices, not a live offer.

Where can I have it delivered?

Ask about the US, Europe, Japan, South Korea, Southeast Asia, Middle East and Brazil. Product eligibility, delivery charges and language support are confirmed for your specific destination.

Do I own the headset?

No. This proposed offer uses rented equipment. The rental duration, return deadline and any refund or damage charges must be approved before launch.

Can I pay monthly?

This demo shows an annual subscription only. No monthly installment plan or discount comparison is offered.
